waybackify cache verify [flags]

Verify a cache root against its own sidecars

Verify a populated cache root against its own sidecars: re-hash every
body, re-derive every path, and flag the shapes a crash, a bit-flip,
or a short fetch leaves behind — including a page whose requisite
closure is incomplete (a referenced im_/cs_/js_/oe_ capture with no
sidecar in this store). Report-only by default.

Output: a per-category report on stdout (--json for the raw report).
Exit 0 when the store is clean (or made clean by --fix), 1 when any
discrepancy remains.

Flags:
  --root|-r <root>   cache root to verify (contains cap/ meta/ tmp/ and the trash/ quarantine) — required
  --fix              move orphan cap/ files to trash/<run>/ and delete stale tmp/ scratch (opt-in); never deletes a body, never touches corruption or a short closure; assumes no concurrent writer
  --restore <run>    move the bodies of one quarantine run (a directory name under trash/) back to cap/; a body whose live path is occupied is skipped and reported, never replaced; runs before the verify
  --empty-trash      delete the bodies in the trash/ quarantine (the only action that deletes a body file); runs after the verify report, keeps this run's moves and any body a current sidecar names
  --json             emit the raw report as JSON (for tooling/checkpoints)
  --quiet            suppress the per-category "ok" lines
  --help|-h          Show help

part of the wayback mirror tooling
